rules: Opening Range = first N minutes of RTH (9:30-10:00 ET). Frozen after N minutes. Entry: 1-min bar closes above OR high (long) or below OR low (short). Stop: below/above OR boundary. Exit: 3:55 PM ET. Position: 5% of capital risked per trade (capital / OR range).

variant_results.assessment: Disaster — too noisy, too many low-quality trades
Slightly negative — shorter OR is better
Short side adds losses, not profits
200-day MA filter reduces trades but doesn't improve edge

biases_identified: Fill assumptions: using breakout bar close is optimistic (real fills at next bar open)
No transaction costs: $0.50-$1/contract would erode the break-even variants
Survivorship bias: all 16 tickers are alive today (no delisted failures)
Time period: 30 days is too short for statistical significance
Overfitting: testing 5 variants increases chance of false positives
key_takeways: 15-min ORB is the only break-even variant (PF 1.00) — shorter is better
Short side is a money-loser (PF drops when adding shorts)
200-day MA filter reduces trades by 10% but doesn't improve win rate
Median trade is slightly negative across all variants
